# V1.13.4

Section: Source

**V1.13.4** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on January 15th, 2025.

## V1.13.4

- Feature - [#2835](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2835) Viewing scope component
- Rework - Removed deprecated parts from preset starter boat
- Rework - [#26201](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/26201) added group id return value to spawnVehicle and spawnAddonVehicle
- Fix - [#26292](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/26292) MC editor not sorting logic block items on open
- Fix - [#26370](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/26370) Stopped winches autospooling when not using number node for reeling
- Fix - [#26550](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/26550) Typo in inverse pyramid 1x2 name
